reviews.title: Ads via notifications
reviews.text:
I installed this to help with my productivity but before I even got a chance to use it properly, I was being served ads via notifications.

You would think turning on notifications for a productivity timer app was reasonable…

…until it starts delivering ads, without warning or consent, or a way to opt out. That’s just wrong for a productivity app.

reviews.title: It has some glitches
reviews.text: Some times the timer doesn’t make any sound so I lost my streak of keeping concentrated

reviews.title: Video ads in a focus timer?
reviews.text: Great app, totally down for ads, but really…putting video ads in an app to help one focus seems pretty thoughtless.

reviews.title: BE WARNED: Pornography ads!!
